Stark "Well, you're cleaning statues..."
Friern: "Don't say that, Stark. Look, I see it."
Fern "It's a statue of the brave Lord Himmel, isn't it?"
Frieren "But look, there's a stranger standing next to it. That's another sign of the times."
Stark "Frieren, what are you talking about?"
Fern "Yes, it is. This is, no matter how you look at it, a statue of Tsukishima-sama."
Frieren "Wow, you two know this guy."
Stark "What the hell are you talking about..."
Frieren "?"
Fern "...Frieren-sama, this man is Tsukishima Shuukuro-sama. He raised his sword to defeat the Demon King
...... and accomplished it. Just like you, he is a member of the group of heroes, right?"

Tsukishima: "Hello, Frieren, it's been a long time. Have you been well?
